visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a navy blue t-shirt and a matching baseball cap stands at a stainless steel kitchen sink, washing several heads of bright green broccoli. Water flows steadily from a modern silver faucet into the basin. The kitchen features white countertops and a dark, glossy kitchen island in the foreground. (2) The man is now at a wooden cutting board, using a knife to peel a large white vegetable, possibly a radish or potato. He is focused on the task, holding the vegetable firmly with his left hand while peeling with his right. The background shows a modern oven and a silver refrigerator. (3) He continues his preparation by slicing a dark red piece of meat on the yellow cutting board. His movements are efficient and practiced. Various kitchen tools like scissors and a bowl are visible on the counter beside him. The lighting is bright and even across the room. (4) The man moves across the kitchen, carrying a small bowl and placing it on the white counter. He is wearing patterned shorts. The camera angle is wide, capturing the spacious layout of the modern kitchen with its high-end appliances and sleek cabinets. (5) Close-up shots transition through the prepared ingredients: a bowl of bright green broccoli, a bowl of sliced white vegetables, yellow kiwi fruit, and a plate of cooked meat seasoned with sliced green onions. Each dish is presented in a separate, colorful ceramic bowl or plate. (6) The final shot displays the full meal spread on the white kitchen island. It includes the meat, vegetables, fruit, a bowl of fish soup with visible steam, and small side dishes containing nuts and mushrooms. The background shows the professional-grade stove and cooking pots.

The sound of water fades out, leaving the music as the primary acoustic layer. (3) The track maintains a high energy level with steady percussion and harmonic support from an electric bass. No ambient room noise or speech from the environment is audible, indicating a professional mix where the commercial track is the focus. (4) The music reaches a bridge section where the vocal melody rises in intensity. The spectral balance remains bright and clear. The rhythmic structure is consistent throughout, providing a rhythmic anchor for the visual edits before ending with a final guitar chord.

It uses a fast-paced montage to show the efficiency of the process, concluding with a satisfying display of multiple dishes including meat, vegetables, and soup.
